rejected.name: CGHEVEN

rejected.name: Stylized Textures
rejected.reason: catalogue is loaded client-side from categories.json, which robots.txt disallows (*.json), so no allowed way to search it

rejected.name: The Base Mesh

rejected.name: Sloyd free 3D models
rejected.reason: free models are outputs of an AI generator (about 733 listed), robots.txt disallows /search and the list uses a Load more button with no search; AI-generated content

rejected.name: Meshy free 3D models
rejected.reason: gallery of AI-generated models from a generator service, not a curated asset catalogue

rejected.name: Open3dModel
rejected.reason: automated requests get HTTP 403, and it reports no new models this week, so access and freshness could not be verified

rejected.name: AMD GPUOpen MaterialX Library
rejected.reason: keyless API lists about 454 free materials, but the licence and plain-GET package downloads were not verified this run; worth a closer look later

rejected.name: NIH 3D
rejected.reason: Next.js app with no documented public search API (robots.txt and guessed API paths return 404 pages); mostly 3D-printing biomedical models

rejected.name: NASA 3D Resources
rejected.reason: about 375 free NASA models, but the listing and filters are JavaScript-driven, not in the WordPress REST API, and the content-list endpoint is undocumented, so no reliable search

rejected.name: Thingiverse
rejected.reason: automated requests get HTTP 403 and it is a 3D-printing STL site that needs an API token

rejected.name: MyMiniFactory
rejected.reason: automated requests get HTTP 403; 3D-printing models with mixed paid licences

rejected.name: CraftPix
rejected.reason: automated requests get HTTP 403 and most assets are paid under a custom licence

rejected.name: Printables
rejected.reason: automated requests get HTTP 403 and it is a 3D-printing site with a login-gated GraphQL API

rejected.name: FurniMesh

rejected.name: Cinevva game assets
rejected.reason: aggregator of Kenney, Quaternius, Poly Haven, ambientCG and others we already search; robots.txt disallows /api/

rejected.name: game-icons.net
rejected.reason: about 4,000 CC-BY 2D SVG icons, but search is client-side Algolia and listings span six sitemaps, too many requests per search; not 3D

rejected.name: BlendSwap
rejected.reason: automated requests get HTTP 403, so no search access could be verified

rejected.name: FreePBR
rejected.reason: automated requests get HTTP 403 and textures are personal-use only with a paid commercial licence

rejected.name: Icosa Gallery
rejected.reason: public keyless API with about 130,000 CC0/CC-BY models, but uncached searches took 30-35 seconds, longer than the server's 15 second request timeout; mostly Tilt Brush sketches

rejected.name: Texture Labs
rejected.reason: photographic 2D textures for Photoshop with no catalogue in the WordPress REST API (posts endpoint reports 0), so no reliable search

rejected.name: Public Domain Textures

rejected.name: OpenHDRI
rejected.reason: CC0 and downloadable, but only about 60 HDRIs so far; too small for now (same bar as GobKit)

rejected.name: CGEES
rejected.reason: every page is behind a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge and robots.txt blocks /api and AI bots, so no automated search

rejected.name: KayKit (Kay Lousberg)
rejected.reason: only a handful of packs on a static page and the downloads are hosted on itch.io, which we already search

rejected.name: The Met 3D models

rejected.name: Smithsonian 3D

rejected.name: Poly Pizza
rejected.reason: every page including robots.txt is behind a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge, so no automated search; most models are CC-BY

rejected.name: PolyScan

rejected.name: Mixos

rejected.name: GobKit
